neighbours.label: the word/token 'Horn'/'horn' (Cape Horn, Horn of Africa, horns)
fire: The clipper rounded Cape Horn in a violent storm.
Drought has hit farmers across the Horn of Africa.
He plays the French horn in the city orchestra.
The driver leaned on the horn at the red light.
A rhino uses its horn to defend its young.
The ship sounded its fog horn as it left the harbor.
Aid agencies warned of famine in the Horn region.
The bull lowered its horns and charged the fence.
quiet: The clipper rounded the southern cape in a violent storm.
Drought has hit farmers across East Africa.
He plays the cello in the city orchestra.
The driver leaned on the brakes at the red light.
A rhino uses its weight to defend its young.
The ship sounded its bell as it left the harbor.
Aid agencies warned of famine in the eastern region.
The bull lowered its head and charged the fence.
